note:
Recommended in _Where_Should_We_Camp_Next?_ by Stephanie Puglisi
At about 2,400 ft, the highest state-park campground in Vermont, in spruce-fir-birch forest around Adams Reservoir beside the George Aiken Wilderness. The shore sites (Loop B's T36-T45, Loop C's T63-T73) look at the water through a line of trees; a 2.7-mile trail circles the lake. --Claude
summary: Park page + RA site list/season dates + 2026 map: 76 tent/RV (60 RV-capable), max 35 ft, 43 sites 28 ft+; no hookups; flush toilets, token showers, dump, water. Fees $20/$38 (+$2 prime) confirmed. WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview recommended (shore pads behind a tree line). Phone empty -> 802-447-7169. Pin at the office ~570 m from the loops: move recommended. Season manual (05-22/10-11) left; 2027 opens May 28.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, recommend lakeview): the booking site tags Near Water on RV-capable T36 (35 ft), T40 (20), T42 (28), T44 (20), T45 (35), T66 (35), T67 (20), T69 (28), T70 (30), T72 (28), T73 (35) (plus tent-only T22, T23, T38, T39), all sold by the night. Its own photos: T42's gravel pad ends at a row of conifer trunks with the reservoir just behind them; T45 sees water between trees; T36, T66, T70 and T73 show only woods. Leaf-off Esri imagery puts Loop B's west-edge pads ~10-40 m from the east shore (~42.8868,-73.0378) inside a continuous shoreline conifer belt, and the map draws the loops' spurs ending short of the shoreline. Behind a line of trees with no open ground to the water = a view: lakefront -> lakeview. No --AWH value involved.

PIN MOVE: stored 42.8912,-73.0385 is the park office/contact station by VT 9, north of Adams Reservoir. Loops A and B (sites 1-55) lie on the reservoir's east shore around ~42.8870,-73.0363 and Loop C (56-87, cabins) on its south shore around ~42.8843,-73.0392 (Esri imagery). Recommend ~42.8862,-73.0372, ~570 m from the stored pin.

SEASON (manual, not overwritten): stored 05-22/10-11. The page says 'Friday of Memorial Day Weekend through the second Monday in October' and the booking site's 2027 season is 'Fri May 28 2027' - 'Sun Oct 10 2027' (last night), so 10-11 is right for 2027 and 05-22 is the 2026 opening (2027: 05-28).

NOTE: the --Claude line 'Campground wraps around Adams Reservoir with multiple sites directly on the shoreline' is incorrect against the photos and imagery (tree line between pads and water) - replaced. Kept the book recommendation line verbatim.
INCLUSION EVIDENCE: describes this campground (76 tent/RV + 20 lean-tos, dump station) - fine.
